Try the late-change reporting workflow
  1. Save the original report. In Bordereaux, generate a report from the initial premium. Download the CSV to inspect the snapshot.
  2. Record the endorsement. In Endorsement, add a description, an effective date, an insured value of 28,000,000 and a premium adjustment of 10,000.
  3. Generate the next report. Return to Bordereaux. The next report contains only the new adjustment. Both snapshots remain available; Settlement shows their carrier obligations.

Use the original sample record to reproduce the website example. All changes stay in this browser; exporting a report does not send it to a carrier.
